            return

        closes = list(self._five_minute_closes)
        fast = sum(closes[-5:]) / 5.0
        slow = sum(closes) / 20.0

        if (
            self._previous_fast is not None
            and self._previous_slow is not None
            and self._previous_fast <= self._previous_slow
            and fast > slow
            and time(9, 45) <= bar.EndTime.time() <= time(14, 30)

            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped: no SPY option chain in Slice.")
            return

        min_expiry_date = self.Time.date() + timedelta(days=7)

            contract.Expiry.date()
            for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call

            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped: no call expiration at least 7 calendar days away.")
            return

        selected_expiry = valid_expiries[0]
        calls = [
            contract for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and contract.Expiry.date() == selected_expiry
        ]

        if not calls:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped: no calls at selected expiration.")
            return

        # No other strike rule was specified; choose the closest available strike to SPY.
        underlying_price = float(self.Securities[self.spy].Price)
        if underlying_price <= 0:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry skipped: SPY price unavailable.")
            return

            calls,
            key=lambda c: (abs(float(c.Strike) - underlying_price), float(c.Strike))
        )

        self._entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self._entry_expiry = contract.Expiry.date()

        self.Debug(
            f"{self.Time}: Entry submitted: 1 {contract.Symbol}, "

            self._held_contract is None
            or self._entry_fill_price is None
            or self._exit_order_id is not None
            or self.Portfolio[self._held_contract].Quantity == 0

        ask = float(quote_contract.AskPrice)

        if midpoint >= 1.50 * self._entry_fill_price:

            or self._held_expiry is None
            or self._exit_order_id is not None
            or self.Portfolio[self._held_contract].Quantity == 0

            self.Time.date(),
            self._held_expiry

        if self.Time.date() >= self._held_expiry:
            self._no_new_entry_date = self.Time.date()

                self._submit_exit("expiration processing")

        quantity = self.Portfolio[self._held_contract].Quantity

        self._exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Exit submitted for {self._held_contract}: {reason}.")

    def _liquidate_unexpected_spy_position(self):
        spy_quantity = self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity

                self._entry_expiry = None

            elif order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid):
                self.Debug(f"{self.Time}: Entry order closed without fill.")

                self._entry_expiry = None

        if order_event.OrderId == self._exit_order_id:

        prior_fast = self.fast.Current.Value
        prior_slow = self.slow.Current.Value
        were_ready = self.fast.IsReady and self.slow.IsReady

        self.slow.Update(point)

            contract.Expiry.date()
            for contract in chain
            if contract.Expiry.date() >= minimum_expiry_date
        })

            self.Debug(f"Skipped entry {signal_bar_end:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M}: no expiry at least 7 calendar days out")

        self.pending_entry_expiry = selected.Expiry

        )

            minute=(bar.Time.minute // 5) * 5,
            second=0,
            microsecond=0
        )

        if self.bucket_start is not None and bucket_start != self.bucket_start:
            self.bucket_start = bucket_start
            self.bucket_times = set()
        elif self.bucket_start is None:

            for i in range(5)
        }

        self.held_expiry = None

        previous_slow = sum(self.closes[i] for i in range(20)) / 20.0

        self.closes.Add(float(bar.Close))

        current_fast = sum(self.closes[i] for i in range(5)) / 5.0
        current_slow = sum(self.closes[i] for i in range(20)) / 20.0

        end_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        eligible_time = time(9, 45) <= end_time <= time(14, 30)

        if (eligible_time
                and previous_fast <= previous_slow
                and current_fast > current_slow):
            # OnData receives this same time slice, including its option chain.
            self.signal_time = bar.EndTime

    def OnData(self, data):
        self.HandleUnexpectedSpyPosition()

        if self.held_option is not None and self.Portfolio[self.held_option].Invested:
            if self.Time.date() >= self.expiration_date:
                self.no_entry_date = self.Time.date()
                self.SubmitExit("expiration-day protection")
                return

            previous_trading_day = (
                self.Securities[self.spy]
                .Exchange.Hours
                .GetPreviousTradingDay(self.expiration_date)
                .date()
            )

            if (self.Time.date() == previous_trading_day
                    and self.Time.time() == time(15, 45)):
                self.SubmitExit("15:45 pre-expiration exit")
                return

            self.CheckProfitTarget(data)

        if self.signal_time is not None and self.signal_time < self.Time:
            # A signal is valid only for the Slice immediately following its bar.
            self.signal_time = None

        if self.signal_time != self.Time:
            return

        self.signal_time = None

        if self.no_entry_date == self.Time.date():
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: expiration protection is active today.")
            return

        if (self.entry_order_open
                or self.exit_order_open
                or (self.held_option is not None
                    and self.Portfolio[self.held_option].Invested)):
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: an option position or order already exists.")
            return

        if not data.OptionChains.ContainsKey(self.option_symbol):
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: no SPY option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        chain = data.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        minimum_expiry = self.Time.date() + timedelta(days=7)

        valid_expiries = sorted({
            contract.Expiry.date()
            for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and contract.Expiry.date() >= minimum_expiry
        })

        if not valid_expiries:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: no call expiration meets the 7-calendar-day rule.")
            return

        selected_expiry = valid_expiries[0]
        calls = [
            contract for contract in chain
            if contract.Right == OptionRight.Call
            and contract.Expiry.date() == selected_expiry
        ]

        if not calls:
            self.Debug("Skipped entry: selected expiration has no eligible calls.")
            return

        # No strike rule was specified; use the nearest-to-spot call deterministically.
        spot = float(self.Securities[self.spy].Price)
        selected = min(
            calls,
            key=lambda contract: (
                abs(float(contract.Strike) - spot),
                float(contract.Strike),
                contract.Symbol.Value
            )
        )

        ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1)
        self.entry_order_open = True
        self.entry_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.Debug(
            f"Entry submitted: {selected.Symbol.Value}, expiry {selected_expiry}, "
            f"strike {selected.Strike}."
        )

    def CheckProfitTarget(self, data):
        if self.exit_order_open or not data.QuoteBars.ContainsKey(self.held_option):
            return

        quote_bar = data.QuoteBars[self.held_option]
        if quote_bar.Bid is None or quote_bar.Ask is None:
            return

        bid = float(quote_bar.Bid.Close)
        ask = float(quote_bar.Ask.Close)

        if bid <= 0 or ask <= 0:
            return

        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
        if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_fill_price:
            self.SubmitExit(
                f"50% profit target reached at midpoint {midpoint:.2f}"
            )

    def SubmitExit(self, reason):
        if (self.held_option is None
                or self.exit_order_open
                or not self.Portfolio[self.held_option].Invested):
            return

        for order in self.Transactions.GetOpenOrders(self.held_option):
            if order.Quantity < 0:
                self.Transactions.CancelOrder(order.Id)

        quantity = -self.Portfolio[self.held_option].Quantity
        ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.held_option, quantity)

        self.exit_order_open = True
        self.exit_order_id = ticket.OrderId
        self.Debug(f"Exit submitted: {reason}.")

    def HandleUnexpectedSpyPosition(self):
        spy_holding = self.Portfolio[self.spy]

        if not spy_holding.Invested:
            self.spy_cleanup_open = False
            return

        if not self.spy_cleanup_open:
            self.spy_cleanup_open = True
            self.Debug(
                "Unexpected SPY exercise/assignment position detected; "
                "submitting immediate liquidation."
            )
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -spy_holding.Quantity)

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if order_event.OrderId == self.entry_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.entry_order_open = False
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.held_option = order_event.Symbol
                self.entry_fill_price = float(order_event.FillPrice)
                self.expiration_date = order_event.Symbol.ID.Date.date()

                self.Debug(
                    f"Entry filled: {self.held_option.Value} at "
                    f"{self.entry_fill_price:.2f}."
                )

            elif order_event.Status in (
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid
            ):
                self.entry_order_open = False
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.Debug("Entry order did not fill.")

        if order_event.OrderId == self.exit_order_id:
            if order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
                self.Debug(f"Exit filled: {order_event.Symbol.Value} at "
                           f"{float(order_event.FillPrice):.2f}.")
                self.exit_order_open = False
                self.exit_order_id = None
                self.held_option = None
                self.entry_fill_price = None
                self.expiration_date = None

            elif order_event.Status in (
                OrderStatus.Canceled,
                OrderStatus.Invalid
            ):
                self.exit_order_open = False
                self.exit_order_id = None
                self.Debug("Exit order did not fill.")

        if order_event.Symbol == self.spy and order_event.Status == OrderStatus.Filled:
            self.spy_cleanup_open = False
